The accused conspired with associates Hassan Ali alias Chaous and Muneer to hire Kishan alias Pappu who carried out the plan, resulting in Moizuddin's death outside his home.  The police commissioner stated that the Khans believed their legal setbacks were due to the deceased’s involvement in several legal proceedings against them.

recent_articles.title: Woman doctor of Dera Bassi hospital 'attacked' by 2 men; staff suspend OPD services in protest - The Tribune
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A woman doctor, **Jot Noor**, an anaesthetist at the Dera Bassi Sub-Divisional Hospital, was attacked by two unidentified men on Friday morning. The attack occurred after she was questioned about her profession and subsequently assaulted.  **Dr Noor** filed a complaint with the police, and hospital staff suspended outpatient services in protest of what they described as inaction from authorities and lack of security measures. **Dr Dharminder Singh**, the Dera Bassi Sub-Divisional Officer (SMO), confirmed a police complaint was filed and a case registered.

recent_articles.title: 8 Held After Violent Clash Inside Police Station In Odisha's Baripada | OdishaBytes
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Baripada Town police** responded to a violent clash between two groups of youths at the police station on Friday evening.  The incident, which involved vandalism and assault, led to the arrest of eight individuals for their involvement in the altercation. **Police** sources said that the clash stemmed from an argument between youths from Baripada and Dhanpur areas over a car ride.

recent_articles.title: Uttar Pradesh man repeatedly slams toddler to ground, kills him to marry child’s mother - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A man, **Viraj**, has been accused of killing a one-and-a-half-year-old boy named Aarav in Uttar Pradesh's Firozabad.  **Viraj**, who allegedly wanted to marry the child's mother, **Rati**, is suspected of repeatedly slamming the toddler onto the ground after taking him from his aunt's house. The incident was captured on CCTV and police have launched a manhunt for **Viraj**.

recent_articles.title: Reshuffle in Udhampur Police, SHOs, officers transferred
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **District Police Udhampur** has ordered the transfer and posting of several officers with immediate effect. **Inspector Purshotam Kumar** was transferred from Rehmbal to Ramnagar, while **Inspector Nishant Gupta** moved from DPL Udhampur to Chenani.  **Inspector Parvez Sajad**, currently at DPL Udhampur, will assume charge as SHO of Udhampur after the relieving of the current officer, **Abhijeet Sirohi**. Other transfers include **Inspector Sumit Magotra** moving to Rehmbal and **PSI Manveer Singh** being transferred from Ramnagar to Udhampur.  **PSI Varun Sharma** has been moved to Battal Ballian as Incharge Police Post, while **PSI Ravinder Kumar** was transferred from Battal Ballian to Udhampur. The transfers are intended to improve the administration and efficiency of the police department across the district.

recent_articles.title: Fake Cockroach Janta Party App Spreading Malware, Cyber Security Firm Warns | OdishaBytes
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **TraceX Labs**, a Mumbai-based cybersecurity firm, has warned of a fake Android app mimicking the popular satirical **Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)** that steals personal information. The report, published on May 22nd, reveals the app requests numerous permissions and connects to suspicious websites after installation.  Experts say criminals are exploiting meme culture and political trends to distribute this spyware through unofficial APK links, particularly targeting younger users.  The researchers urged users not to download APK files from unofficial sources and asked **Abhijeet Dipke**, founder of the CJP platform, to publicly confirm the app's unrelated status.

recent_articles.title: Indian Man Paid Traffickers To Assault Minor In US; Sentenced To 10 Years | OdishaBytes
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kavankumar Patel**, a 27-year-old Indian man working at the AmericInn hotel in Omaha, Nebraska, was sentenced to 10 years in prison for sexually assaulting a minor girl after paying human traffickers. **Eduardo Jose Perdomo**, **Michel Martinez-Gonzalez**, and **Alfredo Zambrano-Hurtado** were also charged with sex trafficking of minors.  The investigation began on January 6, 2025, when police discovered evidence of sex trafficking at the hotel. The Homeland Security Task Force and the Omaha Police Department rescued two minor girls who had been brought to the hotel from out of state for commercial sex.
